title: ONE
notes: The first screen asks for a language: English, Spanish, Italian, French or German.

You must create a fighter before you can play. The left soft key is Continue on each creation screen; on the last one type a name on the number keys (like texting: 2 gives A, 3 gives D) and press the left soft key to save.
Play > Single-player has Versus, Survival, Story and Training.
Either soft key pauses a fight. The pause menu has Settings > Customise Controls and the Skills list of moves.
Multiplayer over Bluetooth and N-Gage Arena is not available in the browser.

controls.source: The game's defaults, read from its Settings > Customise Controls screen (keys 3 to 9). Directions, OK and the soft keys were observed in menus and in a fight.

actions.left: Move left (in a fight); change a setting (menus)
actions.right: Move right (in a fight); change a setting (menus)
actions.rsk: Back (menus); pause and resume (in a fight)

notes: Fighting layout: move on the arrows; A punches, S kicks, D grabs and Z defends; X, C and V switch to the offensive, neutral and defensive pose. The digit keys work too and are needed to type the fighter's name.

On a gamepad X punches, A kicks, B grabs and RB defends; LB, RT and LT are the offensive, neutral and defensive pose. Start selects in menus and pauses a fight, Back goes back, Y is OK. Typing the fighter's name needs the keyboard or the touch keypad.

statusNote: Logos, language choice, menus and fighter creation work, and a single-player Versus fight in the 3D dock arena plays: moving, punch, kick and the pause menu were tried.
